name: claude-mods
description: Context band, one-press handoff, and a build plan and DoD side pane for Claude Code.

plugins.name: context-band
plugins.description: Context zone band above the prompt, with a one-press Handoff and a rolling handoff draft.

plugins.name: plan-pane
plugins.description: Side pane with Build Plan and DoD tabs for the current build plan and DoD ledger. Open with /plan-pane.

plugins.name: stash
plugins.description: Stash a session's context and git state, then resume it exactly, from any tool. /stash, /stash:resume, /stash:list, /stash:merge.

plugins.name: build-plan
plugins.description: Phased, test-first build plans you work top to bottom from chat. /build-plan-init, :resume, :add, :next, :reorder.

plugins.name: dod
plugins.description: Per-ticket Definition-of-Done ledgers, verified with real evidence, plus a PR gate that asks before opening a PR on a non-green ledger.
